title: La IA ‘podría acabar con nosotros’: Extrabajador de OpenAI y Anthropic alerta por riesgos para la humanidad
summary: Jacob Coxon, quien trabajó como investigador de IA en Anthropic y OpenAI, advirtió tras renunciar que ninguna de las dos empresas actúa de forma responsable y que la carrera por desarrollar superinteligencia autónoma podría poner en riesgo a la humanidad para finales de la década. Sus declaraciones se suman al debate sobre la falta de gobernanza y controles de seguridad en el desarrollo acelerado de modelos de IA.

title: Google Plans €13 Billion AI Infrastructure Investment in Finland
summary: Google plans to invest at least €13 billion ($15.1 billion) to build AI infrastructure in Finland, marking Alphabet's largest single investment in Europe to date. The buildout underscores the scale of capital being committed to AI data-center capacity as enterprise AI adoption accelerates globally.

title: Apollo's Kleinman Says Legacy Portfolio Firms Have a Valuation Issue
summary: Apollo co-President Scott Kleinman said legacy portfolio companies are facing a valuation issue as the rising cost of capital weighs on returns, speaking at the IPEM conference in Paris. He argued private equity can no longer count on multiple expansion and must create value through operational improvement instead.

title: Tikehau's Flamarion Says Transaction Are Becoming 'Smaller'
summary: Tikehau Capital co-founder Antoine Flamarion said private equity deal volumes are shrinking and transactions are getting smaller, pointing to secondary markets as the sector's "massive trend." He made the comments to Bloomberg from the IPEM conference in Paris.

title: Aumento del gasto social en estados presionaría balance operativo: Moody’s
summary: Moody's Local México advirtió que el gasto social de los gobiernos estatales creció a una tasa promedio anual de 17% entre 2022 y 2025, absorbiendo una mayor proporción del gasto operativo y reduciendo el espacio fiscal de 19 entidades calificadas. La calificadora señala que esta tendencia, alineada con el gasto federal, podría presionar los balances operativos estatales hacia adelante.

title: Grupo México y BlackRock buscarán nuevos proyectos en América tras cerrar fusión de activos eléctricos
summary: Grupo México, del empresario Germán Larrea, y una subsidiaria de BlackRock cerraron la fusión de sus activos de generación eléctrica con Saavi, una transacción valuada en US$800 millones que crea uno de los mayores generadores privados de México junto con Global Infrastructure Partners. Ambas compañías ahora buscarán nuevos proyectos de infraestructura energética en México y otros países de América.

title: Anthropic withheld latest AI model from UK testing agency
summary: Anthropic declined to give the UK's AI Security Institute early access to its latest model, a decision that has stoked concern inside the British government about a protectionist shift among leading AI developers. The move raises questions about how AI labs are engaging with independent safety testing as regulatory scrutiny of frontier models grows.

title: AI borrowing boom shakes up Swiss credit market
summary: Bonds issued by AI infrastructure spenders such as Alphabet and Amazon have made up more than a quarter of Swiss franc corporate issuance this year, reshaping a credit market historically dominated by domestic borrowers. The surge illustrates how AI capital-expenditure financing is spilling into global fixed-income markets.

title: Paquete Económico: Prevé Hacienda déficit fiscal de 3.9 por ciento del PIB en 2027
summary: La Secretaría de Hacienda estima que los Requerimientos Financieros del Sector Público llegarán a 3.9% del PIB en 2027, por encima del 3.5% previsto en los Pre-Criterios, aunque representa una reducción acumulada de 1.8 puntos porcentuales frente a 2024. El gobierno afirma que mantendrá la ruta de consolidación fiscal sin recortar los programas sociales prioritarios.

title: Propone CSP reformas a aduanas, pagos digitales y catastro
summary: La presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum envió al Congreso una iniciativa para reformar la Ley Aduanera, junto con dos iniciativas adicionales para crear nuevas leyes en materia de pagos digitales y catastro. Las reformas propuestas podrían tener implicaciones directas para la infraestructura de pagos digitales y el marco regulatorio financiero en México.

title: Sheinbaum sube 3.1% recursos para vivienda social: Destinará 34 mil millones de pesos en 2027
summary: El gobierno de Sheinbaum incrementó 3.1% el presupuesto del Programa de Vivienda Social para 2027, hasta 34,353 millones de pesos, con el que planea otorgar 240,000 apoyos a hogares de bajos ingresos en rezago habitacional. El aumento se enmarca en los Criterios de Política Económica 2027 y refuerza el gasto público dirigido a financiamiento de vivienda para la población de menores ingresos.

title: Fundraising frenzy for China AI lab DeepSeek spawns shadow market
summary: A new funding round for Chinese AI lab DeepSeek has triggered a rush of investment vehicles offering exposure to the company, with escalating fees and five-year lock-ups as demand outstrips available shares. The frenzy highlights how capital is chasing China's leading AI developers even as direct access remains restricted.

title: US Says Alibaba, DeepSeek Have ‘Systematically’ Siphoned AI Models
summary: US security agencies accused Chinese AI companies including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI's Kimi of systematically extracting proprietary knowledge from American AI firms, and warned Silicon Valley developers to better protect their models. The allegations add to escalating US-China tension over AI intellectual property and model security.

title: Paytm Bets on Workplace AI Agents in Pivot Beyond Payments
summary: Indian digital payments pioneer Paytm is expanding into workplace AI agents, joining the broader agentic-AI push as it looks to reaccelerate revenue growth beyond its core payments business. The pivot illustrates how fintech incumbents are turning to AI agents to diversify revenue and defend market position.

title: LIV Golf se declara en bancarrota; buscan versión reducida
summary: LIV Golf se declaró en bancarrota en Nueva Jersey con más de 500 millones de dólares en deudas, y sus responsables buscan ahora relanzar el circuito en una versión reducida. El colapso financiero marca un giro drástico para el proyecto respaldado por el fondo soberano saudíta que buscaba competir con el PGA Tour.

title: China’s AI-Fueled IPO Boom Delivers Six-figure Windfalls to Retail Investors
summary: China's AI-driven IPO boom is delivering outsized paydays to retail investors, with some winning gains equivalent to six months' salary in a single trading day. The rally reflects surging investor appetite for AI-linked listings even as valuations climb rapidly.

title: Kroll CEO: Borrower Quality on New Deals Remain Firm
summary: Kroll CEO Jacob Silverman said borrower quality on new private-market deals has held firm, revisiting concerns raised earlier in the year about growing pains in the sector. Speaking as one of the largest valuation agents in private markets, he said little has changed materially over the past four to five months.

title: Cisco President on Defending Against AI Attacks
summary: Cisco President Jeetu Patel discussed an open letter signed by Cisco, OpenAI, Anthropic and other firms warning that AI-enabled cyberattacks are likely to grow more widespread and sophisticated. He noted the same AI tools that boost productivity can also let bad actors operate at machine scale, underscoring rising AI-driven cybersecurity risk.

title: How Indian Workers Are Helping Train the Robots That Will Replace Them
summary: A Bloomberg Big Take Asia episode examines how Indian workers are using iPhones to generate real-world training data for humanoid robots, feeding a global race for the data needed to advance robotics. The piece explores what this data race means for the future of work as automation capabilities expand.
